input.prompt: Single magnificent precision astronomical telescope, crafted solarpunk observatory centerpiece, full object studio product photograph, three-quarter view. Long ivory enamel refractor barrel angled 30 degrees upward, generous dark teal optical glass front lens, heavy warm aged brass altitude fork and visible convincing mechanical pivots. Carved pale sandstone octagonal pedestal on a sturdy broad stepped circular stone base. Subtle incised botanical and celestial ornament; walnut adjustment handles, elegant copper hardware. All components solidly connected, no thin floating ornaments. Whole object including base entirely in frame with margin, centered occupying 80% of square, seamless off-white background, balanced soft neutral studio lighting with gentle shadows. Only one telescope. No people, lettering, labels, scenery, collage, cutaway, floor props or watermarks. A real usable architectural game prop, not a stylized icon.
